objective: Fix Profile Page Auth - Resolve E2E authentication issues where guest pages redirected to sign-in.
blocking_issue: Accessibility/DOM nesting defect in ProfileManageForm.tsx causing Playwright 'getByLabel' failure.

events.description: Identified that client-side Supabase SDK could not read session cookies due to 'httpOnly: true' attribute set by server.
events.outcome: Confirmed root cause of redirection loop.

events.action: Forced 'httpOnly: false' for injected session cookies in E2E tests.
events.result: Resolved authentication redirection. Page now loads correctly with authenticated user data.

events.action: Updated default TEST_EMAIL to match the fixture user ('e2e-test-guest@nabatable.com').

events.description: Tests failing with 'Element not found' for 'Email Address' label despite content being visible in debug dump.
findings: Debug dump showed correct HTML content.
Shadcn 'FormControl' was wrapping a 'div' (icon wrapper) instead of the 'Input' directly.
This caused the Label to be associated with the 'div' via 'for' attribute, leaving the Input unlabeled.
Playwright 'getByLabel' correctly failed to find the input.

action_plan: Remove temporary debug logs from 'page.tsx' and 'layout.tsx'.
